plan.scope: new synthetic-only architecture, no patient loader/queue integration, no frozen PCA content targets
plan.architecture: Own-modality Gaussian shared posteriors, actual shared samples averaged for G; normalized Gaussian private slots conditioned on stop-gradient G; role-tagged Deep Sets mean readout of all private slots
plan.objective: survival NLL + .1 cross-modal observed mean prediction + shared_weight*mean directional cross KL + private_weight*mean slot soft capacity hinge
plan.optimizer: Adam .003, no clipping; record all finite gradient norms and failure if nonfinite
plan.selection: fixed final update; no validation checkpoint/architecture/weight selection from this exploratory matrix
plan.evaluation: five separately scored stochastic forwards, average their NLL; not NLL of averaged logits/hazards, not five new trainings; posterior mean diagnostics separately labeled
plan.attribution: four arms have identical architecture, initial parameters, data, batches and noise; isolates shared KL/private budget, not deterministic-to-stochastic architecture conversion or patient benefit
plan.shift: shared observed nuisance follows WSI task bit in training/probe fit/validation and reverses in test; shared predictability alone is not expected to solve this shift
required_gates_before_training: private rate direct gradient detached from shared head
metrics: sample/mean shared versus true shared/private factors
pooled-private risk increment conditioned on G
plan.meaning_limits: no bound-certified clinical disentanglement; multi-draw prediction has a different information budget; geometry/negative probes do not establish information absence; legacy deterministic prototype and original SlotSPE/V2 patient comparisons remain separately unverified
